text_block_list.text: One day, went to watch mock race—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yahoo, Nature☆ Ready to run marvelous in 
today's race... too?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? Looking down, Nature? Worried 
about race? You okay?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: —Huh?! Ah, no no, nothing, I'm fine.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Teio and McQueen. Those two running 
same mock race too.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text: Ah... yeah. Guess so.

text_block_list.name: Male Spectator
text_block_list.text:
Good luck, Teio! Expecting your usual 
running!

text_block_list.name: Female Spectator
text_block_list.text: McQueen, do your best! Cheering for you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Man, huge cheers as usual. Sparkly horse 
girls really are on another level~

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Brows furrowed tight, Nature? Feeling 
anxious?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
...Nah, same as always. I'm just twisted 
like this, y'know?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Whaaat!! Not true at all!! You're always 
sparkling, Nature!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Even if I try hard, best I manage is 
around 3rd place—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Then think about it this way!! Getting top 
3 in 10-runner race is 3 in 10 odds!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Not everyone can pull that off!! Miracle 
only you can make happen!!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
B-But still. I don't give off that "giving 
it my all" vibe.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Compared to sparkly girls, crowd won't 
find it rewarding to cheer for me—

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
—Whaaat!! Not true at all!! Makes people 
wanna cheer for you so much!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Because you don't fake anything in 
public!! Always natural!! Being natural is 
most wonderful thing, right?!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Shopping district folks loving you is 
proof!! Because you stay natural, everyone 
wants to support you, Nature!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Nature is miracle, lucky, happy, and super 
super marvelous!!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Have way more confidence!! Brings you more 
happiness! And makes your fans happy too!!

text_block_list.name: Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text:
...Hm, what's with commotion? Nature and 
Marvelous...?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Geh, drew entire crowd without 
noticing...!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
See, everyone thinks you're amazing too! 
That's why all eyes on you!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, that's not it! Your voice is just 
crazy loud!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Let's declare loud for all to hear☆ Nature 
is super marvelooous★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh, fine... already! I get it! I get 
it, so keep it down, please...!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... That felt like a whole month's 
worth of exhaustion hitting all at once.

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Well, still... I'll at least take the 
thought. ...Thanks.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Waaaah! Nature's back on her feet! Yay yay 
yay~☆ So haaaappy!★

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
L-Like I said, keep it down, will you...! 
Jeez...!
